entities.name: Mihailo Čanak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mihailo Čanak was a Serbian architect and researcher. He was born in Belgrade, on 2 June 1932. He is a founder and a board member of Center for Housing CS in Belgrade. He holds a PhD degree from the University of Belgrade Faculty of Architecture.
